name: colpool-functions
description: ColPool Cloud Functions and emulator test harness

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: node scripts/emulator-env.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-colpool "node --test --test-concurrency=1 functions/test/*/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/emulator-env.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-colpool "node --test --test-concurrency=1 functions/test/e2e/*.e2e.ts"
